data.one_liner: Customizable multi-select and single-select dropdown widget for Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides a dropdown widget supporting single and multi-selection, searching, form validation, and programmatic control via a controller. It allows customization of items, chips, search fields, and dropdown panels.
use_when: You need a multi-select or single-select dropdown with search capabilities in a Flutter form.
You require programmatic control over selected items, filtering, and dropdown state.
avoid_when: Your project still relies strictly on standard Flutter material widgets and has not migrated to package:material_ui.
strengths: Supports both single-select and multi-select modes with search and form validation.
Extensive customization options including chips, item builders, and async data loading.
weaknesses: Requires migrating Material imports and app themes to package:material_ui in version 4.0.0+.
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter 3.47+ and Dart 3.13+, with a direct dependency on material_ui.
